rateLimits.note: "The global rate limit for the Cloudflare API is 1,200 requests per five minute period per user", shared by the dashboard, API keys and API tokens: counted here for the whole application, the stricter form (several tokens of one user share it). Past it, every call is refused with a 429 for the next five minutes.
Client API per IP: 200 a second (counted for the whole application, the stricter form).

provenance.notes: The limits page (read 2026-11-10) gives 1,200 requests per 5 minutes per user and 200 a second per IP; Enterprise customers may ask Support for more. Cloudflare answers Ratelimit and Ratelimit-Policy fields and a Retry-After on a 429; this provider goes through cloudflare/sdk's Guzzle adapter, so only a 429's fields are read (successful answers' headers are not exposed by the SDK). records() follows the pages (100 records each) inside one operation: the first is the registry's call, each further page goes through the provider's guard under records, checked before it is sent (the zone lookup before the first page is not counted). The Self-Serve Subscription Agreement (last updated 2025-09-12) does not address commercial use, caching or storage of what the API answers; it forbids circumventing Service-specific usage limits (2.2.1(c)) and selling access to the Services to a third party (2.2.1(a)). Not a data source: rights unknown rather than guessed.
